title: individual
description: A single individual (DIFF §3). Parameter overrides are split into individualParameterSets, referenced by parameterSets[].

species.description: OSP species name; free string in v6 (OPEN_QUESTIONS §3).

population.description: OSP population/db name; free string in v6 (OPEN_QUESTIONS §3).

gender.description: Free string in v6; conventionally MALE/FEMALE (OPEN_QUESTIONS §3).

proteinOntogenies.description: String grammar 'Protein:Ontogeny[, ...]' (DIFF §12.2). Clean set promotes to an array of objects.

$comment: PROVISIONAL: additionalProperties pending team decision (see ISSUE_additionalProperties.md). species+gender required (DIFF §3.4).
